description: Gets a vendor's GitHub App or GitHub Action listed on GitHub Marketplace and, for apps, selling there - free vs paid listing, publisher verification, marketplace_purchase billing duties, immutable pricing plans, enterprise buyers Marketplace cannot bill, the verified creator badge, delisting. Use whenever a vendor mentions GitHub Marketplace, listing a GitHub App, Marketplace paid plans, or selling through GitHub billing. Publisher side only; not for buying or allowlisting Marketplace apps as a customer. Do NOT use for building the action (use samber/developer-platform-skills@github-action-offering), repository growth (use samber/developer-platform-skills@github-engagement-playbook), or launch announcements (use samber/developer-platform-skills@app-marketplace-launch-marketing).
